integrity: The exact exhaustive sign-chamber enumeration and analytic spherical-probability proof are included, with a replayable standard-library verifier. Finite case enumeration is exhaustive only after the chamber-corner reduction.
scientific_limitations: Almost-sure Haar law only for regular icosahedron central plane sections. The 20/12 great-circle chamber tessellation and per-chamber spherical area fractions were already published (Frederick and MathPages); only the incidence of section polygon type with chamber type is claimed as distinctive. Equivalent unindexed forms remain possible.
title: Exact Haar polygon-type law for central icosahedron sections
